ITEM PARAGRAPHS
At
the
beginning
of
the
1990s
,
foreign
aid
had
begun
to
improve
slowly
.
Scrutiny
by
the
news
media
shamed
many
developed
countries
into
curbing
their
bad
practices
.
Today
,
the
projects
of
organizations
like
the
World
Bank
are
meticulously
inspected
by
watchdog
groups
.
Although
the
system
is
far
from
perfect
,
it
is
certainly
more
transparent
than
it
was
when
foreign
aid
routinely
helped
ruthless
dictators
stay
in
power
.
